purpose: Read-only system-library candidates for the regulator schematic; candidate metadata only, not verified physical mating, pin numbering, current path, or assembly fit.
method: Official installed EasyEDA CLI Invoke-Lceda.ps1, read-only LIB_Device.search / LIB_Device.get / LIB_Symbol.search / LIB_Symbol.get. No schematic/page mutation.
pinNumberPolicy: actualPinNumbers is null until the candidate is placed and its live primitive pins are read. Do not infer pin order from name, footprint, or pin count.

selectedCandidate.pinNumberLimitation: Library search/get metadata does not expose the placed primitive pin-number list; verify after placement with SCH_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(...).getState_PinNumber().
selectedCandidate.assessment: PCB screw terminal candidate. Library lists 15 A; catalog does not verify 6-32 or M6 thread, single-electrode lug geometry, or mating hardware. Confirm manufacturer drawing and footprint before use.

alternate.pinNumberLimitation: Library search/get metadata does not expose the placed primitive pin-number list; verify after placement with SCH_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(...).getState_PinNumber().
alternate.assessment: Same general terminal family; catalog lists 15 A. Thread size and mechanical fit remain unverified.

powerTerminal.searchFinding: No confirmed M6 PCB lug or exact Keystone 8192 item found in the inspected system-library searches. Do not call this an M6 or 6-32 connection.

nearCandidate.name: FP1308-R21-R
nearCandidate.pinNumberLimitation: Library search/get metadata does not expose the placed primitive pin-number list; verify after placement with SCH_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(...).getState_PinNumber().
nearCandidate.assessment: Not a qualifying choice: system library rates it 68 A current and 72 A saturation, with an SMD footprint; it is below the requested 100 A and not through-hole.

genericSymbol.assessment: Symbol only; leave MPN, supplier, voltage/current rating and safety claims blank until an external fuse is specified.

externalFuse.searchFinding: No Eaton AMG-80 exact device was found.
